resources.string: Payment status uses available evidence through %1$s; it does not reconstruct status at the end of a historical month.
These settings apply to Beta only and never create financial transactions.
Configuration storage is unavailable in this build. No changes were saved.
Configuration changed since this editor opened. Reload and review your changes.
Check the name, amount, day and dates. Use a positive amount with at most two decimal places and a month such as 2026-10. Date changes cannot remove a manually paid month.

Leave the day blank to remove this setting. Short months use their last available day. Salary day 27 moves to 26 on Friday or 28 on Saturday. Details show the actual period dates; a calendar month is not a salary or statement period.
Save the displayed draft within Beta only. No financial transaction will be created.
View preferences could not be saved. Review the choices and try again.
Approved transactions in the displayed calendar month only. A drilldown does not change full summary totals.
Read only. Opening details never approves or reposts a transaction.
